People over machines: Russia turns to manual labor amid technological decline and equipment shortages Russia’s economy is facing a shortage of technology rather than workers, according to a new study by the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation, cited by the Russian newspaper Nezavisimaya Gazeta. The study says that years of insufficient investment in modernization have left businesses struggling with a lack of machinery and automation. As a result, companies are being forced to rely on millions of workers to perform manual tasks, including to fulfill state defense contracts. According to the research, investment in machinery and equipment as a share of total capital accumulation in Russia fell from 43.9% in 2005 to 14.7% in 2024. “What is currently happening in the Russian labor market can be described as the price of ‘technological lag.’ This is a consequence not so much of a demographic slump as of a profound investment and fiscal crisis. We are searching for millions of workers only because we failed to replace them with machines and robots over the past decade,” the researchers wrote.

They also cast doubt on recent reports of a successful crossing of the Oskil by Russian units in the Sadove area. ➡️ In a lengthy video from the center of Kupiansk-Uzlove, a Ukrainian serviceman without body armor or helmet walks around and comments on current news (Vladimir Putin's interview with Emir Kusturica ). In the footage, the Ukrainian commander managed to walk in close proximity to the Holy Protection Church. These fragments were filmed ~November 22-23. ➡️ And already today, response footage appeared from Russian Armed Forces units operating here. A serviceman walked through the same places where Kovalev had walked several days earlier, carefully filming the same location with fresh snow. Given that snow fell in the region and those areas today — the video and date raise no doubts. ❗️ But the fact that over the course of several days, one and the same location can first be traversed by a Ukrainian, and then by a Russian serviceman — once again serves as evidence of the sparseness of combat operations and the conditional nature of "control zones." It takes just one side to "scare off" the other with drones, and a "window" appears for action on the street while opponents wait out the drone threat. In Kupiansk itself, there are no signs of a change in the situation yet. There continue to be reports of fighting on the northern and western outskirts. However, if the AFU advances on the eastern bank and partially restores the bridgehead, Russian Armed Forces positions west of the Oskil will again come under threat. Especially since Ukrainian formations have room to develop their offensive there: Glushkovo remained under stable AFU control. " ዛሬ ለደቡብ ትግራይ ቢሮዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ደመወዝ ወደ አካውንታቸው ገብቷል " - ቴዎድሮስ አረጋይ (ዶ/ር) 👉 " የፌደራል መንግስት ገንዘቡን ገቢ ካደረገ ሳምንት ሆኖታል " - አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ የትግራይ ክልል ባለአደራ አስተዳደር፣ ወደ ስራ ገበታ ተመልሰው በአካል ሪፖርት ላደረጉ ሠራተኞች ከጥቅምት 30 ቀን 2019 ዓ/ም ጀምሮ ደመወዝ እንደሚከፍል ገልጾ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ትናንትም ሆነ ዛሬ ወደ ሠራተኞች… " ' 100 ሠራተኞች አሉ ' ብለው ሪፖርት ያቀርባሉ ስናጣራ ግን 50፣ 60 ናቸው ትክክለኛ። በርሃ ያሉ ሰዎች ስላሉ መሳሳት የለብንም " - ቴድሮስ አረጋይ (ዶ/ር) የትግራይ ባለአደራ አስተዳደር፣ ለሁሉም ባይሆንም የጠራ ሪፖርት ላቀረቡ ቢሮዎችና ወደ ስራ መመለሳቸውን ሪፖርት ላደረጉ የመንግስት ሰራተኞች ደመወዝ መከፈሉን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጿል። ቃላቸውን የሰጡ የክልሉ ሠራተኞች፥ የዘንድሮ ጥቅምት ወር ደመወዝ ክፍያ መፈጸሙን፣ ሆኖም ከዚሁ ክፍያም አሁንም ያልተከፈላቸው ሠራተኞች እንዳሉ፣ በ2013 ዓ/ም ጦርነት ወቅት ያልተከፈላቸው የ17 ወራት ደመወዝ አሁንም እንዳልተከፈለ፣ ክፍያው እንዲፈጸምላቸው ጠይቀዋል። የሰራተኞቹን ጥያቄ ይዘን ያናገርናቸው የባላአደራ አስተዳደሩ የኢኮኖሚና መልሶ ግንባታ ዋና ሥራ አስፈጻሚ ቴድሮስ አረጋይ (ዶ/ር)፥ " የጸዳ ፔይሮል ለሰሩ ቢሮዎች፣ ሴክተሮች አጠናቀናል " ብለዋል። ለወረዳዎችና ዞኖች ገንዘቡ ወደ አካውንታቸው መግባቱን፣ በጀት መልቀቃቸውን፣ ነገር ግን ፔይሮል ያላጣሩ እንዳሉ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል። " ' 100 ሠራተኞች አሉ ' ብለው ሪፖርት ያቀርባሉ፤ ስናጣራ ግን 50፣ 60 ናቸው ትክክለኛ ፤ በርሃ ላይ ያሉ ሰዎች ስላሉ መሳሳት ስሌለብን ነው " ሲሉም ለሁሉም ክፍያ ለመፈጸም የተቸገሩበትን ምክንያት አስረድተዋል። " ገንዘቡ ወዳልተፈለገ ቦታ እንዳላክ የማጣራት ስራዎች አሉ " ያሉት ዋና ሥራ አስፈጻሚው፣ የተጣራ ሪፖርት ላቀረቡ ቢሮዎች ክፍያ ተፈጽሞ ለሠራተኞችም ደመወዝ እጃቸው እንደገባ ገልጸዋል። በተያያዘ፥ በ2013ቱ በነበረው ጦርነት የወራት ደመወዝ ስላለመፈጸሙ አሁንም ከሠራተኞቹ ጥያቄ እየቀረበ ሲሆን፣ ቴዎድሮስ አረጋይ (ዶ/ር) ስለጉዳዩ ከሳምንት በፊት ጠይቀናቸው፣ እሳቸው የሚያውቁት፥ በአሁኑ ወቅት እየፈጸመ ያለው ክፍያ የባለአደራ አስተዳደሩ ከተሾመበት ጊዜ በኋላ ያለውን መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። በሌላ በኩል፥ ነዳጅ ወደ መቐለ ከተማ መግባቱን ከሰሞኑ መገለጹ የሚታወስ ሲሆን፣ በሌሎቹ ከተሞችስ እንዴት ነው ሲል ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ጠይቋል። በሁሉም የትግራይ ከተሞች ነዳጅ እንዲገባ መፈቀዱን ቴድሮስ (ዶ/ር) ገልጸዋል። " ከዚህ በፊት ክልከላ ነበር፤ አሁን ክልከላቸው ተነስቷል፤ ከጂቡቲ አስጭነው ማምጣትና ስራውን ማስቀጠል የባለሃብቶች ስራ ነው " የሚል ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል። ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አዲስ አበባ ህዳር 16 ቀን 2019 ዓ/ም @tikvahethiopia

Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko has extended visa-free entry to Belarus for citizens of 38 countries through 2027, the presidential press service said. The press service added that the entry conditions remain unchanged. Citizens of the listed countries may enter through any international road or rail checkpoint using valid travel documents. Stays are limited to 30 days from the date of entry, except for citizens of Poland, Lithuania and Latvia and holders of non-citizen legal status in Latvia, who can stay for up to 90 days. Visa-free entry may be used an unlimited number of times, provided the total stay does not exceed 90 days per calendar year. The visa-free entry procedure through Belarusian airports also remains in place.
